{{Top|leg}}
'''Liquid crystal''' was a substance used in display panel screens. In one of its [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceports]], [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] employed 105 liquid crystal panels measuring 30 x 30 cm.<ref name="CGTST">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref> The [[Falasian liquid crystal]] was an unusual type of gemstone.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
